tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background for the report, the admin page and the demo page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, table rows, the verdict block and the widget panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Quoted source passages, inputs and code. Text and text-muted stay legible on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, quiet buttons, choices and question IDs. Holds 3:1 on surface and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ground, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta lines and captions on ground, surface and surface-sunken (6.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Verification ink, the only accent on Citemark surfaces: links, primary buttons, citation markers and the mark in the wordmark. As text on ground, surface or ink-soft. Never a state.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ink text: a citation marker at rest on Citemark surfaces, a selected row.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill, such as the primary button label.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Met the target, or answered correctly. Always with the pass glyph and a word. As text on surface, ground or pass-soft.

tokens.name: pass-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind pass text in a StateMark.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Missed the target, or answered wrongly. Always with the fail glyph and a word. pass and fail have similar lightness, so never tell them apart by color alone.

tokens.name: fail-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind fail text in a StateMark.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Within 5 points of the threshold, or needs a human look. Always with the warn glyph and a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text in a StateMark.

tokens.name: declined
tokens.usage: Correctly declined. A neutral slate, because declining is correct behavior, not a failure. Always with the declined glyph and a word.

tokens.name: declined-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind declined text in a StateMark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid keyboard focus outline with a 2px offset, on every interactive element. Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: widget-accent
tokens.usage: The widget's accent, set by the client (defaults to ink). The admin page darkens a client color until on-widget-accent holds 4.5:1 on it. Used for the launcher, send button, user messages, outlined citation markers and source links.

tokens.name: on-widget-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a widget-accent fill: the launcher, the send button, the user's own messages.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The report verdict and page titles. One per page.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Card and group headings, such as a FixPlanGroup title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels above values and in table headers. Set text-transform: uppercase. Color text-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The help center doesn't say whether deleted messages are included.
styles.usage: Running text on the report, admin page and demo page.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running text and the owner line of a fix plan.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Split long settings articles by heading.
styles.usage: Table cells, notes and form help.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Judge agreed with human grading on 38 of 40.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The count in a MeasureRow. Always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Percentages, targets, costs, ticket numbers and effort estimates.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Question IDs and small figures in tables.

styles.name: widget-body
styles.sample: Admins can export every public channel from Organization settings.
styles.usage: Messages in the widget. At runtime the family is the host page's own font; the system stack is the fallback.

styles.name: widget-meta
styles.sample: Answers come from the Acme Chat help center.
styles.usage: Source titles, the disclosure subtitle, status lines and form help.

styles.name: widget-marker
styles.usage: Citation marker numerals in the widget.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a message: answer, sources, buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between messages; widget header padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; gap between measure columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Report card padding; gap between report sections' items.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between fix-plan meta columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Report page top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-core
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, inputs and rows on the report, admin page and demo page.

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: The widget panel and message bubbles. The client may set 0 to 16px; inner controls use two thirds of it.

tokens.name: radius-marker
tokens.usage: Citation markers, StateMarks and question IDs.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The launcher button.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The open widget panel, the launcher and menus. Nothing else is raised.

tokens.name: z-widget
tokens.usage: Launcher and panel: above page content, below the host page's own dialogs. Clients may override it.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.usage: Hover, focus and state changes. 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: The widget panel opening and closing, and progress bars. 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: size-launcher
tokens.usage: Launcher diameter.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control.

tokens.name: size-widget-width
tokens.usage: Widget panel width on screens wider than size-sheet-breakpoint.

tokens.name: size-sheet-breakpoint
tokens.usage: Below this width the widget panel becomes a full-screen sheet.
